description: Presets system for the xrpld config generator — groups network, role, size, and verbosity under a presets object. Each preset dimension drives a cluster of xrpld.cfg settings with merge order: common < size < role < verbosity < network < user.

userStories.title: Preset types and XrpldInput restructure
userStories.description: As a developer, I want new types for presets so the generator has a structured interface for high-level configuration knobs.
acceptanceCriteria: Add NodeRole type: 'stock' | 'validator' | 'ephemeral' | 'sentry' | 'clio' | 'feature' | 'hub'
Add NodeSize type: 'tiny' | 'small' | 'medium' | 'large' | 'huge'
Add LogLevel type: 'silent' | 'fatal' | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info' | 'debug' | 'trace'
Add XrpldPresets interface with optional fields: network, role, size, verbosity
Add 'readonly presets?: XrpldPresets' to XrpldInput
Remove top-level 'network' field from XrpldInput (moved to presets.network)
Export NodeRole, NodeSize, LogLevel, XrpldPresets from types/xrpld-input.ts
Typecheck passes: cd packages/generator && npx tsc --noEmit
Fix any broken tests/imports referencing top-level input.network
userStories.notes: Breaking change to XrpldInput — network moves into presets. All references to input.network must become input.presets?.network. Since the package is internal/unpublished, this is acceptable.

userStories.title: Size preset defaults
userStories.description: As a user, I want to pick a node size that automatically configures node_size, database settings, peer limits, and worker counts.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/generator/src/defaults/sizes.ts
Export getSizeDefaults(size: NodeSize): Partial<XrpldInput>
Export VALID_SIZES as ReadonlySet<string>
tiny: node_size=tiny, online_delete=256, ledger_history=256, peers_max=10
small: node_size=small, online_delete=256, ledger_history=512, peers_max=15
medium: node_size=medium, online_delete=512, ledger_history=1024, peers_max=21
large: node_size=large, online_delete=2048, ledger_history=4096, peers_max=50, workers=4, io_workers=2
huge: node_size=huge, online_delete=8192, ledger_history=full, peers_max=300, workers=8, io_workers=4
All size presets use NuDB at /var/lib/xrpld/db/nudb with advisory_delete=0
Create packages/generator/tests/defaults/sizes.test.ts with tests for all 5 sizes
Each size returns a valid Partial<XrpldInput>
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Size presets handle resource/capacity tuning. Role presets handle operational behavior — no overlap.

userStories.title: Role preset defaults
userStories.description: As a user, I want to pick a node role that automatically configures operational behavior like port layout and peer visibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/generator/src/defaults/roles.ts
Export getRoleDefaults(role: NodeRole): Partial<XrpldInput>
Export VALID_ROLES as ReadonlySet<string>
stock: empty object (current behavior preserved)
validator: peer_private=1, 3 ports (peer, rpc_admin_local, ws_admin_local — no gRPC)
ephemeral: empty object (resource tuning is handled by size preset)
sentry: peer_private=0
clio: ledger_history=full, 4 ports with gRPC on ip=0.0.0.0 and secure_gateway=0.0.0.0
feature: amendment_majority_time='5 minutes'
hub: peer_private=0
Role presets must NOT set node_size, node_db, online_delete, or worker counts (that is size's job)
Create packages/generator/tests/defaults/roles.test.ts with tests for all 7 roles
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Roles focus purely on operational behavior. Size handles capacity. Users combine both via presets.

userStories.title: Verbosity preset defaults
userStories.description: As a user, I want to pick a verbosity level that automatically configures the xrpld log level.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/generator/src/defaults/verbosity.ts
Export getVerbosityDefaults(level: LogLevel): Partial<XrpldInput>
Export VALID_LOG_LEVELS as ReadonlySet<string>
Each level sets rpc_startup to [{ command: 'log_level', severity: '<level>' }]
silent and fatal both map to severity 'fatal'
error, warning, info, debug, trace map to their respective severity values
Create packages/generator/tests/defaults/verbosity.test.ts with tests for all 7 levels
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Future versions could add per-partition log levels. V1 only controls the global rpc_startup log_level.

userStories.title: Merge pipeline integration
userStories.description: As a developer, I want resolveXrpldConfig to apply all preset layers in the correct merge order so that presets compose predictably.
acceptanceCriteria: Import getSizeDefaults, getRoleDefaults, getVerbosityDefaults into defaults/xrpld.ts
Update resolveXrpldConfig to read presets from input.presets (default: network=mainnet, role=stock, size=medium, verbosity=warning)
Merge order: common < size < role < verbosity < network < user
Remove node_db, ledger_history, and rpc_startup from COMMON_DEFAULTS (now driven by size/verbosity)
COMMON_DEFAULTS retains: server (default ports), database_path, debug_logfile, ssl_verify, sntp_servers, peer_private, fetch_depth
Resolved config includes presets object with resolved values: { network, role, size, verbosity }
resolveXrpldConfig({}) produces identical output to current behavior (backwards compatible: stock + medium + warning + mainnet)
resolveXrpldConfig({ presets: { size: 'huge' } }) has node_size=huge, online_delete=8192, peers_max=300
resolveXrpldConfig({ presets: { role: 'validator', size: 'large' } }) has large db settings + validator ports (3 ports, no gRPC)
resolveXrpldConfig({ presets: { verbosity: 'debug' } }) has log_level=debug in rpc_startup
resolveXrpldConfig({ presets: { network: 'testnet', role: 'clio' } }) has testnet VL keys + clio ports with gRPC on 0.0.0.0
User override wins: { presets: { size: 'huge' }, node_size: 'large' } produces node_size=large
User override wins: { presets: { verbosity: 'debug' }, rpc_startup: [custom] } uses custom rpc_startup
Update packages/generator/tests/defaults/xrpld.test.ts (or defaults.test.ts) with merge pipeline tests
Typecheck passes
All existing tests pass (update any broken by network field move)
userStories.notes: This is the critical integration story. The merge order must be exact: common < size < role < verbosity < network < user. Deep merge replaces arrays entirely (ports, rpc_startup) which is the desired behavior.

userStories.title: CLI and parser integration
userStories.description: As a user, I want CLI flags and text file keys for all presets so I can configure the generator from any input source.
acceptanceCriteria: Add --role flag to CLI parseArgs: validates against VALID_ROLES, stored in CliArgs.role
Add --size flag to CLI parseArgs: validates against VALID_SIZES, stored in CliArgs.size
Add --verbose flag to CLI parseArgs: validates against VALID_LOG_LEVELS, stored in CliArgs.verbosity
--network flag now maps to presets.network (not top-level network)
In run(), build presets object from CLI args (network, role, size, verbosity) and merge into input
Update USAGE string: add --role, --size, --verbose flags with descriptions and defaults
Update USAGE examples to show preset combinations
Add PRESET_NETWORK, PRESET_ROLE, PRESET_SIZE, PRESET_VERBOSITY to env-parser KEY_MAP mapping to presets.network, presets.role, presets.size, presets.verbosity
Keep NETWORK as backwards-compat alias for PRESET_NETWORK in env-parser
parseArgs error for --role without value
parseArgs error for --role with invalid value
parseArgs error for --size without value
parseArgs error for --size with invalid value
parseArgs error for --verbose without value
parseArgs error for --verbose with invalid value
parseArgs with combined --network testnet --role validator --size large --verbose info returns all values
Text file with PRESET_ROLE=validator parses to { presets: { role: 'validator' } }
Text file with NETWORK=mainnet parses to { presets: { network: 'mainnet' } } (backwards compat)
Update packages/generator/tests/cli.test.ts with new flag tests
Update packages/generator/tests/parsers/text-parser.test.ts with PRESET_* key tests
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: CLI flag is --verbose but CliArgs field and preset key are verbosity. The --network flag continues to work as before but internally maps to presets.network.

userStories.title: Preset validation
userStories.description: As a user, I want validation errors and warnings for invalid or misconfigured presets.
acceptanceCriteria: Add validatePresets() function to validation.ts
Invalid role value produces validation error
Invalid size value produces validation error
Invalid verbosity value produces validation error
Invalid network value produces validation error
role=validator without validator_token or validation_seed produces warning: 'validator role requires validator_token to participate in consensus'
role=sentry without ips_fixed produces warning: 'sentry role should have ips_fixed pointing to the validator it protects'
role=clio with gRPC port not on 0.0.0.0 produces warning (in case user overrode ports)
role=stock does not produce role-specific warnings
Valid presets do not produce errors
Call validatePresets() from validateXrpldConfig()
Update packages/generator/tests/validation.test.ts with preset validation tests
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Validator without token is a warning, not an error — users may generate config before having the token. Suppress the generic 'no validator_token' warning when the role-specific one fires to avoid duplicates.

userStories.title: Exports, examples, and integration tests
userStories.description: As a developer, I want clean exports, updated examples, and end-to-end tests proving the presets system works correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Export from index.ts: getSizeDefaults, getRoleDefaults, getVerbosityDefaults, VALID_SIZES, VALID_ROLES, VALID_LOG_LEVELS
Export types from index.ts: NodeRole, NodeSize, LogLevel, XrpldPresets
Update examples/xrpld-full.json to use presets object: { presets: { network, role, size, verbosity }, ... }
Update examples/xrpld-full.txt to use PRESET_NETWORK, PRESET_ROLE, PRESET_SIZE, PRESET_VERBOSITY
Create packages/generator/tests/integration/presets.test.ts
Integration test: each role x mainnet produces valid cfg via generateXrpldConfig
Integration test: each size produces correct node_size + online_delete in cfg output
Integration test: each verbosity level produces correct log_level in rpc_startup
Integration test: combined { presets: { network: 'testnet', role: 'validator', size: 'large', verbosity: 'info' } } produces expected cfg
Integration test: {} (no presets) produces identical cfg to current default behavior (backwards compatible)
Integration test: presets object does NOT appear in rendered cfg output
Integration test: text file with PRESET_ROLE=validator + PRESET_SIZE=large produces correct cfg
Integration test: CLI run() with role + size + network + verbose args produces correct cfg
All tests pass: cd packages/generator && npx vitest run
Coverage >= 80%: cd packages/generator && npx vitest run --coverage
Typecheck passes: cd packages/generator && npx tsc --noEmit
userStories.notes: This is the final story. Ensure backwards compatibility is proven by test: no presets = stock + medium + warning + mainnet = current output.
